title: Outstanding PLE Results — 2024 Class Shines
excerpt: We are proud to announce that our P7 class achieved remarkable results in this year's Primary Leaving Examinations, with 92% of learners passing in Division One and Two.

title: Annual Sports Day — Celebrating Young Champions
excerpt: Last Friday, our school compound was alive with energy as learners, parents, and teachers came together for our much-anticipated Annual Sports Day. What a day of fun and achievement!

title: New Science Laboratory Officially Opened
excerpt: St. Lawrence School is thrilled to welcome a brand-new, fully-equipped science laboratory. This facility will give our learners hands-on experience in science experiments from an early age.

title: Reading Week — Building a Culture of Learning
excerpt: During our Reading Week, every class put down their textbooks and enjoyed stories, poems, and creative writing. The enthusiasm shown by our learners was truly inspiring.

title: Tree Planting Drive — We Go Green!
excerpt: In line with our commitment to environmental stewardship, St. Lawrence School partnered with local organisations to plant over 200 trees across our school grounds and the wider community.

title: Term Two Registration Now Open
excerpt: Term Two 2025 registration is officially open. We encourage all parents to complete enrollment early to secure your child's place. Bursaries are available for qualifying families.
